scenes.vo: This film opened with just ten lakh rupees. It ended above four hundred and fifty crore. How?
scenes.cap: Opened with ₹10 lakh. Ended above ₹450 crore. How?

scenes.vo: Hanuman Ansh released on August seventh. Its entire first week in India: about one crore net.
scenes.cap: Hanuman Ansh, released 7 Aug 2026. Week 1 India net: ₹1.08 cr

scenes.vo: By week two, it was down to just twenty nine shows across India. Most films die right here.
scenes.cap: Start of week 2: just 29 shows across India

scenes.vo: Then word of mouth took over. Week three, ten crore. Week four, sixty one crore. Week five, ninety crore.
scenes.cap: Week 3: ₹10.4 cr · Week 4: ₹61 cr · Week 5: ₹90.25 cr

scenes.vo: Week five alone was over eighty times week one. Less than half a percent of its total came in the first two weeks.
scenes.cap: Week 5 = 80x+ week 1. Under 0.5% came in the first 2 weeks

scenes.vo: Sacnilk's estimate: three hundred forty three crore net in India, and four hundred fifty three crore gross worldwide.
scenes.cap: Sacnilk estimate: ₹343 cr India net · ₹453 cr worldwide gross

scenes.vo: Most films are judged on Friday. This one won in week four. Would you judge a film by day one? Ten lakh.
scenes.cap: Most films are judged on day one. Would you?
